children: Major U.S. airlines are waiving certain change fees and fare differences for eligible travelers as a nor’easter threatens to disrupt weekend travel across the Northeast.
issued travel waivers covering flights from Friday through Sunday at airports including New York's John F. Kennedy International, LaGuardia, and Newark Liberty, as well as Boston Logan International.

The storm is expected to bring heavy rain, strong winds, and coastal flooding from North Carolina through New England. Forecasters have warned of wind gusts of up to 60 miles per hour, flooding, and possible power outages, with coastal New England facing some of the strongest conditions.

waiver covers 10 airports from Philadelphia to Portland, Maine. Eligible passengers traveling September 25 to 27 can move their flights through September 29 without a fare difference, provided they remain in the same cabin and keep the same cities on their itinerary.

As of Friday morning, delays and cancellations remained limited as airlines continued to assess the storm's path.
